Usage inside InoAgents
----------------------

minimp3.h is a single-header C library. It is included with the
MINIMP3_IMPLEMENTATION macro from exactly one translation unit —
Private/Audio/InoAgentsAudioMp3Decoder.cpp — and is never referenced
from any public header. This keeps minimp3's ~1900 lines of decoder
code isolated to a single TU and keeps Unreal's public header set
clean of third-party decoder types.

To update the vendored copy:
    1. git clone https://github.com/lieff/minimp3 (or curl the raw file)
    2. Copy minimp3.h to this directory, overwriting the old one
    3. Update the "Pinned" line above with the new commit SHA
    4. Rebuild InoAgents and re-run InoAgents.Audio.PlayMp3Test to
       confirm no regression
